from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:stockpile-coarse" and r._field == "value_overflow_forecast_properties_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: При ремонте мельницы — сразу; иначе — если склад растёт дольше 15 модельных минут (приход больше расхода)

panels.title: Предел мощности: недобор руды и меди

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:plant-sulphide" and r._field == "value_power_limit_lost_ore_properties_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Недобор руды, т/ч"})

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:plant-sulphide" and r._field == "value_power_limit_lost_cu_shift_properties_value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Медь за смену, т"})

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:stockpile-coarse" and r._field == "value_hours_to_full_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "До переполнения"})
